requirement: On each committed authoritative game event, write a deterministic human-readable text mirror with event ID, game ID, event sequence, UTC wall time, period, game clock, operator ID, event type and before/after values.
acceptance_test: Unit+integration: 100-event game log matches ordered journal projection.

requirement: Text mirror is append-only; never overwrite or delete original event entries when corrected.
acceptance_test: Unit: correction appends referencing original event ID; original bytes unchanged.

requirement: SQLite event journal and outbox commit atomically before acknowledging a scoring action; text mirror is a secondary recoverable projection.
acceptance_test: Crash injection between commit, mirror write and ACK; exactly-once journal effect.

requirement: If text mirror write fails, surface a persistent degraded-logging alert and enqueue retry; do not silently claim dual logging succeeded.
acceptance_test: Inject disk-full and permissions error; alert + rebuild from journal.

requirement: Allow full or selected game log export to .txt and .jsonl with integrity metadata and no unnecessary personal information.
On startup, compare last mirrored sequence against journal sequence and rebuild missing lines idempotently.
acceptance_test: Kill after journal commit before text append; restart and reconcile.

requirement: Allow configured independent secondary destination for exports/backups; report storage health and ensure no direct network path can block clock operations.
acceptance_test: Unplug secondary drive midgame; authoritative scoring continues.

requirement: Goal scorer shall be roster player or TBD; assist 1 and assist 2 shall independently be roster player, TBD or None.
acceptance_test: Unit/UI: all supported combinations persist and render.

requirement: None means no credited assist; TBD means attribution unresolved. They must remain distinct in storage, statistics and scoresheet.
acceptance_test: Unit: no assists counted for None or TBD; TBD remains visible.

requirement: Entering a goal with TBD shall immediately adjust team score exactly once and preserve an immutable goal event ID.
Later attribution shall append a correction linked to goal event ID, retaining prior attribution, actor, reason and timestamp without creating another goal.
acceptance_test: Integration: score unchanged; projection reflects corrected scorer.

requirement: Unresolved attributions shall be filterable in scorekeeper and read-only Game Review and reviewed before certification.
acceptance_test: UI/acceptance: unresolved queue and certification gate.

requirement: Validate team membership at game roster snapshot, duplicate assists, scorer-as-assist, and team/period constraints; override requires permission and audit.
acceptance_test: Property tests and authorized override test.

requirement: Read-only live Game Review shall show ordered goals, penalties, corrections, clock actions and provisional/final status without permitting game mutations.
acceptance_test: E2E: observer cannot invoke game command endpoints.

requirement: Authorized questions shall target an immutable event ID, be rate-limited and remain separate from official corrections; notifications nonblocking.
acceptance_test: E2E: coach question queued; no clock impact.

requirement: Single active operator authority shall be enforced across browser/native clients using expiring lease and fencing token.
acceptance_test: Concurrent client command rejection and lease failover test.

requirement: Shared platform data contracts shall not assume goals, periods, ice sheets or hockey-specific penalties; hockey module implements those.
acceptance_test: Architecture test prevents platform->hockey project reference.
